discogs.profile:
[b]Crystal Fairy[/b], briefly known as [b][a=Red Alpha Royale][/b], was a short-lived American alt-rock/stoner supergroup, formed in 2016 by two [b][a=Melvins][/b] members, guitarist [a=Buzz Osborne] and drummer [a=Dale Crover], vocalist [a=Teri Gender Bender] of [b][a=Le Butcherettes][/b], and [a=Omar Rodriguez-Lopez] from [b][a=At The Drive-In][/b] and [b][a=The Mars Volta][/b]. After releasing two 7" singles and a self-titled [url=/master/1140486]CD/LP album[/url] in 2017, the project was abandoned shortly after. [a=Melvins] had already collaborated with [a=Teri Gender Bender] on several occasions in 2015; she opened for the band on a few dates, and occasionally joined as a guest vocalist to sing covers on [i][url=/master/2880268]Fascists Eat Donuts[/url][/i]" by [a=Pop-O-Pies] and [a=Bikini Kill]'s "[i][url=/master/35741]Rebel Girl[/url][/i]." Meanwhile, Teri's band, [a=Le Butcherettes], was signed to Omar's label, [l=Rodriguez Lopez Productions], and they played in [a=Bosnian Rainbows] (2013) and [a=Kimono Kult] (2014) together. In September 2015, Melvins recorded the "[i]Rebel Girl[/i]" cover with [a=Teri Gender Bender], released as a [url=/master/954038]single-sided 7" lathe cut[/url] by [l=Joyful Noise Recordings]. Soon after, they started a new band, [b][i][a=Red Alpha Royale][/b][/i], with [a=Omar Rodriguez-Lopez] joining on bass (which he used to play in [url=/artist/53557]De Facto[/url]).

In October 2016, the Red Alpha Royale's debut [i][r=9198844][/i] 7" single came out on [l=Amphetamine Reptile Records]. The band soon renamed to "Crystal Fairy," ad-libbed by Teri during one of the recording sessions, when she exclaimed, "My name is Crystal Fairy." Allegedly, the title was inspired by [a=Sebastian Silva]'s 2013 independent comedy, [i]Crystal Fairy y el Cáctus Mágico[/i]. (The inaugural seven-inch was reprinted with a revised artwork.) In February 2017, [b]Crystal Fairy[/b] released the eponymous [url=/master/1140486]studio album[/url] on [l=Ipecac Recordings], featuring six more songs and the cover of "[i][url=/master/441807]Possession[/url][/i]" by [a=Tales Of Terror]. Shortly after, however, Crystal Fairy abruptly cancelled the promised tour and went defunct. According to [a=Dale Crover]'s October 2018 interview with a [i]Sight/Sound/Rhythm[/i] music blog, such a rapid cancellation became a "tough loss" for him and Buzz; the artist further claimed Crystal Fairy was "one of [his] favourite things" and both were beyond enthusiastic and fully committed, even planning to put Melvins on hold to focus entirely on what seemingly was a "really special" collaboration.

[b]Lineup[/b]
[a=Teri Gender Bender] – vocals, guitar, keyboards
[a=King Buzzo] – guitar, vocals
[a=Dale Crover] – drums, guitar
[a=Omar Rodriguez-Lopez] – bass, guitar
